scanNote:
13-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (95-bet) - ROK KONSERTI.

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K yorliqda oq '13', chapida 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
12) a) 'Look at the pictures and label them with words from the list. Where would you like to take your friends on your birthday?' Qiya: 'rock concert, cinema, funfair, restaurant, theatre'. SURATLAR: 1 - sahnada aktyorlar (teatr); 2 - qorong'i zalda tomoshabinlar ekranga qaramoqda (kino); 3 - katta olomon, sahna (rok konserti); 4 - karusel (attraksionlar bog'i); 5 - restoranda ovqatlanayotgan oila. b) 'Which is your favourite kind of entertainment?' c) 'Have you ever been to a rock concert? If you have, what was it like?'
13) 'Read the sentences and circle the correct items.' 1 An ALL-DAY EVENT is an event which ... a lasts seven days. b lasts a whole day. 2 If you GIVE SOMEBODY A HAND, you ... a move them. b help them. 3 A STAGE is a platform ... a in a train station. b in a theatre/hall, etc. 4 If you CLAP, you ... a hit your hands together. b bang your feet on the ground. 5 If you LEAN OVER, you ... a bend your body towards sb/sth. b move away from sb/sth. 6 A BAND is ... a a group of actors. b a group of musicians. 7 A LEAD SINGER is ... a the main singer in a band. b a person who sings loud music.

O'NG USTUN:
14) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and answer the questions.' 1 What is the writer's favourite group? 2 What time did the concert start? 3 What was Eddie Easton holding? 4 How did the writer feel after the concert?
15) 'Read the article and match the paragraphs to the headings, then explain the words in bold.' Writer's Feelings ......; Before the Concert ......; During the Concert ......; Place/Date of Concert ......
   OCh SARIQ QUTI 'Unforgettable Moments':
   1: 'Have you ever been to a rock concert? I went to one last Saturday at Pinecrest, a PUBLIC PARK near Bath, and it was fantastic. It was an all-day event with six different bands, including The Runners, my favourite group.'
   2: 'It was only nine o'clock in the morning when I got there, so I watched as they SET UP the speakers for the SOUND SYSTEM. One of the men working there even asked me to help, so I ran over and gave him a hand.'
   3: 'The concert started at eleven o'clock, and since I had helped earlier I was allowed to sit at the EDGE of the stage. I was almost close enough to touch the PERFORMERS. The best part of the concert for me was when The Runners appeared. I couldn't believe it when Eddie Easton, The Runners' lead singer, walked out holding his silver guitar. I felt very excited to be so close to my favourite singer. Everyone started clapping. Eddie stopped right in front of me, leaned over, and told me to enjoy the show. Then he started singing all of his HITS. We all joined in with him and danced to the music. The rest of the concert was wonderful, and everybody had a great time.'
   4: 'Walking home, I felt exhausted, but also DELIGHTED that I had had the chance to see my favourite band and talk to Eddie in front of five thousand people.'
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article again and make notes under the headings in Ex. 15. Then, talk about the writer's experience at the rock concert.'
16) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to Jeff and Cathy, then say where they decide to go and why.' IKKI AFIShA: A - ko'k, teatr niqobi: 'Burton Theatre Co. Presents: "Romeo and Juliet" 8.30pm - 10pm, Tickets - £20, Friday 2nd June'. B - qora, gitarachi: 'Tony King & The Starbusters - Live at the Palais - Friday 2nd June, 10 pm - 1 am, £15'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '95'.

exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va ularni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan belgilang. rock concert, cinema, funfair, restaurant, theatre
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  1 sahnada aktyorlar → theatre
  2 qorong'i zalda tomoshabinlar →
    cinema
  3 olomon va sahna → rock concert
  4 karusel → funfair
  5 restoranda oila → restaurant


⚠ 'A FUNFAIR':

  = attraksionlar bog'i.
  ⚠ 'fair' = yarmarka.


⚠ 'ENTERTAINMENT':

  = ko'ngilochar tadbir.
  ⚠ 'to entertain' = ko'ngil ochmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Where would you like to take your friends on your birthday? b) Which is your favourite kind of entertainment? c) Have you ever been to a rock concert? If you have, what was it like?
exercises.instructionUz: Tug'ilgan kuningizda do'stlaringizni qayerga olib borishni xohlardingiz? b) Sevimli ko'ngilochar tadbir turingiz qaysi? c) Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Agar borgan bo'lsangiz, u qanday edi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ O'z fikringiz.


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO':

  = xohlarmidingiz.


⚠ 'HAVE YOU EVER BEEN TO':

  = ...ga borganmisiz (umrda).
  ⚠ 'been to' = borib kelgan.


⚠ 'WHAT WAS IT LIKE?':

  = u qanday edi?

items.en: Where would you like to take your friends on your birthday?
items.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningizda do'stlaringizni qayerga olib borishni xohlardingiz?
items.answerEn: I'd like to take my friends to a restaurant, because we can talk and eat together.
items.answerUz: Do'stlarimni restoranga olib borishni xohlardim, chunki birga gaplashib, ovqatlanishimiz mumkin.

items.en: Which is your favourite kind of entertainment?
items.answerEn: My favourite kind of entertainment is the cinema. I love watching films.
items.answerUz: Sevimli ko'ngilochar tadbirim - kinoteatr. Film ko'rishni yaxshi ko'raman.

items.en: Have you ever been to a rock concert? If you have, what was it like?
items.uz: Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Agar borgan bo'lsangiz, u qanday edi?
items.answerEn: Yes, I have. It was very loud and exciting, and there were thousands of people.
items.answerUz: Ha, borganman. U juda shovqinli va hayajonli edi, minglab odamlar bor edi.

MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Rok konsertiga borganmisiz? Men
o'tgan shanba Bath yaqinidagi
Pinecrest jamoat bog'ida bo'lgan
konsertga bordim, va u ajoyib edi.
Bu olti xil guruh, jumladan sevimli
guruhim The Runners ishtirokidagi
kun bo'yi davom etgan tadbir edi.

2) U yerga yetib borganimda ertalab
soat to'qqiz edi, shuning uchun ular
ovoz tizimi uchun karnaylarni
o'rnatishini tomosha qildim. U yerda
ishlayotgan erkaklardan biri hatto
mendan yordam so'radi, shuning uchun
yugurib borib unga yordam berdim.

3) Konsert soat o'n birda boshlandi,
va oldin yordam berganim uchun
sahna chetida o'tirishga ruxsat
berishdi. Men ijrochilarga qo'l
tekkizish mumkin bo'lgan darajada
yaqin edim. Men uchun konsertning
eng yaxshi qismi The Runners
chiqqanda edi. The Runners'ning
asosiy xonandasi Eddie Easton kumush
gitarasini ushlab chiqqanida
ishonmadim. Sevimli xonandamga
shunchalik yaqin bo'lganimdan juda
hayajonlandim. Hamma qarsak chala
boshladi. Eddie to'g'ri mening

4) Uyga piyoda qaytarkanman, holdan
toygan, lekin ayni paytda sevimli
guruhimni ko'rish va besh ming odam

bo'lganidan juda xursand edim.


SARLAVHALAR:
  Place/Date of Concert → 1
  Before the Concert → 2
  During the Concert → 3
  Writer's Feelings → 4


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  public park = jamoat bog'i
  set up = o'rnatmoq
  sound system = ovoz tizimi
  edge = chet
  performers = ijrochilar
  hits = xitlar (mashhur qo'shiqlar)
  delighted = juda xursand


⚠ 'INCLUDING':

  = jumladan.


⚠ 'SINCE' (bu yerda):

  = chunki (sabab), 'beri' emas!
  'since I had helped' = yordam
  berganim uchun.


⚠ 'TO BE ALLOWED TO':

  = ruxsat berilmoq.


⚠ 'CLOSE ENOUGH TO':

  = ... uchun yetarli yaqin.


⚠ 'TO APPEAR':

  = paydo bo'lmoq, chiqmoq.


⚠ 'RIGHT IN FRONT OF':

  = to'g'ri oldida.
  ⚠ 'right' = aynan.


⚠ 'THE REST OF':

  = qolgan qismi.


⚠ 'EXHAUSTED':

  = holdan toygan.


⚠ 'HAD HAD':

  = past perfect: 'I had had the
  chance' - imkon bo'lgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and make notes under the headings in Ex. 15. Then, talk about the writer's experience at the rock concert.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani yana o'qing va 15-mashqdagi sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing. Keyin muallifning rok konsertidagi tajribasi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  PLACE/DATE: Pinecrest, public
    park near Bath; last Saturday;
    all-day, six bands
  BEFORE: arrived 9 am; watched
    setting up speakers; gave a hand
  DURING: started 11; sat at edge
    of stage; Eddie Easton, silver
    guitar; clapping; leaned over,
    told him to enjoy; hits; danced
  FEELINGS: exhausted but
    delighted; talked to Eddie in
    front of 5,000 people

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda gapiring: 'He went
  ...', 'He felt ...'
exercises.exampleEn: The writer went to a rock concert last Saturday at Pinecrest, a public park near Bath. It was an all-day event with six bands.
exercises.exampleUz: Muallif o'tgan shanba Bath yaqinidagi Pinecrest jamoat bog'idagi rok konsertiga bordi. Bu olti guruh ishtirokidagi kun bo'yi davom etgan tadbir edi.
modelAnswers: He got there at nine o'clock in the morning and watched the men setting up the speakers. One of them asked him to help, so he gave him a hand.

The concert started at eleven o'clock. He was allowed to sit at the edge of the stage. When Eddie Easton walked out with his silver guitar, everyone started clapping. Eddie leaned over and told him to enjoy the show. Then everybody danced to his hits.
After the concert he felt exhausted but delighted, because he had seen his favourite band and talked to Eddie in front of five thousand people.
modelAnswersUz: U ertalab soat to'qqizda yetib bordi va erkaklarning karnaylarni o'rnatishini tomosha qildi. Ulardan biri yordam so'radi, shuning uchun u yordam berdi.

Konsert soat o'n birda boshlandi. Unga sahna chetida o'tirishga ruxsat berishdi. Eddie Easton kumush gitarasi bilan chiqqanida hamma qarsak chala boshladi. Eddie egilib unga tomoshadan bahramand bo'lishini aytdi. Keyin hamma uning xitlariga raqsga tushdi.
Konsertdan keyin u holdan toygan, lekin juda xursand edi, chunki sevimli guruhini ko'rgan va besh ming odam oldida Eddie bilan gaplashgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to Jeff and Cathy, then say where they decide to go and why. A: Burton Theatre Co. presents "Romeo and Juliet", 8.30pm - 10pm, Tickets - £20, Friday 2nd June. B: Tony King & The Starbusters - Live at the Palais, Friday 2nd June, 10 pm - 1 am, £15.
exercises.instructionUz: Jeff va Cathy'ni tinglang, keyin ular qayerga borishga qaror qilgani va nima uchunligini ayting. A: Burton teatri "Romeo va Juletta"ni taqdim etadi, 20:30-22:00, chiptalar 20 funt, 2-iyun, juma. B: Tony King & The Starbusters - Palais'da jonli konsert, 2-iyun, juma, 22:00-01:00, 15 funt.

⚠ AUDIO KERAK - qaror faqat
yozuvdan.

  B - KONSERT: Tony King & The

  = taqdim etmoq.


⚠ 'LIVE' (sifat):

  = jonli. /laɪv/ - 'live' (fe'l,
  yashamoq) /lɪv/ dan farq qiladi!

  = Company (kompaniya).
